tracks.title: 어깨 펴
tracks.subject: a woman whose boyfriend silently taps her shoulder blade with two fingers every time she slouches over her laptop in their usual café, and she starts slouching on purpose
tracks.caption: Korean twee indie-pop, light and bouncy with a gentle sway. Strummed ukulele playing bright upstroke chords, kalimba doubling the hook in plucked eighth notes, round electric bass walking under the root notes, brushed snare with finger snaps on two and four. Dry bedroom-studio sound with light tape warmth. Female mid-register lead, clearly sung melody, warm and direct. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 104 BPM, A major. Tender and gently teasing. No synthesizer pads, no drum machine, no distorted guitar, no autotune, no rap, no whispered vocal.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - ukulele, kalimba]

[Verse 1]
창가 자리 노트북 앞에
나도 몰래 등이 굽으면
너는 말없이 손가락 두 개
내 날개뼈를 톡톡 쳐

[Pre-Chorus]
잔소리 한 마디 없이
커피만 홀짝 마시면서

[Chorus]
어깨 펴, 어깨 펴
그 두 손가락이 좋아서
오늘은 일부러 구부정하게
너 또 톡 칠 때까지

[Verse 2]
집에 와서 거울을 보면
어제보다 키가 좀 커
근데 혼자 있을 때마다
자꾸 또 등이 굽어

[Pre-Chorus]
이건 너 없이 안 되는
이상한 버릇이 됐나 봐

[Chorus]
어깨 펴, 어깨 펴
그 두 손가락이 좋아서
내일도 일부러 굽혀 앉을게
너 또 웃을 때까지

[Outro - kalimba and ukulele fade]
톡톡, 나 여기 있어
어깨 펴, 네 옆에서

tracks.title: Esok Datang, Bang Lah
tracks.genre: Malay kampung polka (accordion-and-tuba oom-pah comedy song)
tracks.subject: a kampung family whose rotten serambi floorboard has been propped on a paint tin for six weeks because the village handyman Bang Lah answers every call with 'esok'
tracks.caption: Malay kampung polka, an oom-pah comedy song with a call-and-response chorus. Bouncing tuba on the downbeat, accordion chords on the upbeat, a quick clarinet melody doubling the tune, crisp snare drum rolls, handclaps on the off-beat. Live village-hall band recording, roomy and dry. Male lead tenor sings each verse clearly with a playful grin, a unison male chorus answers every line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 128 BPM, G major. Teasing kampung comedy. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap, no rock guitar, no kompang or rebana.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - accordion and tuba, snare roll]
[Verse 1]
Papan serambi dah reput separuh
Kami sendal dengan tin cat lama
Telefon Bang Lah, dia kata jangan risau
Esok pagi abang datang, sumpah
[Chorus]
Esok datang, esok datang
Esok Bang Lah, esok lagi
Dah enam minggu esok dia
Tin cat pun dah naik karat
[Verse 2]
Jumpa dia kat kedai kopi
Tengah main dam dengan Pak Mail
Dia angkat tangan, senyum lebar
Lepas Asar abang singgah
[Chorus]
Esok datang, esok datang
Esok Bang Lah, esok lagi
Kucing pun dah tahu jalan
Melompat lepas papan berlubang
[Bridge - clarinet solo, chorus clapping]
Pagi tadi bunyi motor
Bang Lah turun bawa gergaji
[Outro - full band, tuba and accordion]
Papan baru, paku berkilat
Esok dia nak datang minum kopi

tracks.title: Bubur Untuk Seorang
tracks.genre: Malay 1950s exotica lounge (vibraphone-and-flute space-age bachelor-pad pop)
tracks.subject: a woman living alone who suddenly boils a full periuk of bubur kacang hijau on a Tuesday afternoon for no occasion and spends the week eating it at every meal
tracks.caption: Malay 1950s exotica lounge, space-age bachelor-pad pop. Shimmering vibraphone chords with slow motor vibrato, alto flute lines between phrases, plucked nylon-string guitar, walking upright bass, brushed snare with a light shuffle. Warm tape sound with a little spring reverb. Female lead with a warm mid alto, clearly sung, light male harmony on chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 84 BPM, F major. Wry, easy solo afternoon. No trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no EDM, no electric guitar distortion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - vibraphone and alto flute]
[Verse 1]
Selasa petang, tak ada apa
Aku rendam kacang hijau secawan
Rupanya secawan jadi seperiuk
Santan, gula melaka, daun pandan
[Chorus]
Bubur untuk seorang
Cukup untuk satu kampung
Aku makan pagi, makan petang
Periuk masih separuh penuh
[Verse 2]
Rabu aku panaskan, tambah santan
Khamis aku makan dengan roti
Jumaat aku bekukan dalam bekas
Sabtu aku masih makan lagi
[Chorus]
Bubur untuk seorang
Tak ada sebab, tak ada tetamu
Aku makan sambil tengok hujan
Periuk tinggal satu senduk
[Outro - vibraphone and flute fade]
Minggu depan mungkin pengat
Kali ni aku rendam separuh

tracks.title: 一刀不斷
tracks.subject: an office worker whose secret hobby is peeling an apple in one unbroken strip, practising every night on supermarket apples to beat his own record of two point three metres while his girlfriend is made to eat every apple
tracks.caption: Mandarin new wave guitar pop in the style of early-1980s angular guitar bands. Clean chorus-flanged electric guitar playing choppy staccato riffs and a jittery hook, jumpy melodic bass guitar playing nervous eighth-note runs, tight drum kit with crisp snare backbeat and ticking hi-hat. Dry, tight, angular studio production. Male tenor vocal, bright, slightly nervy and clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 146 BPM, E major. Jittery, deadpan-funny, bouncy mood. No autotune, no rap, no synthesizer, no accordion, no brass, no ballad tempo.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - choppy staccato guitar riff, jumpy bass, tight drums]

[Verse 1]
下班回家關上門
桌上一顆紅蘋果
削皮刀在燈下閃
今晚要破兩米三

[Pre-Chorus]
手腕慢慢地轉
呼吸不要亂

[Chorus]
一刀不斷 一刀不斷
果皮垂到我的腳邊
別說話 別打噴嚏
這一圈是我的戰場

[Verse 2]
她吃到第一百顆
說她牙齒會發酸
我說再陪我一晚
明天換成水梨好嗎

[Pre-Chorus]
兩米二 兩米三
我閉上眼睛

[Chorus]
一刀不斷 一刀不斷
果皮繞過整個客廳
她鼓掌 我才敢喘
這一刀是為你削的

[Outro - clean chorus guitar and bass, last staccato chord]
蘋果給你 皮留給我

tracks.title: 三十支豉油
tracks.subject: a woman who buys thirty bottles of soy sauce on a supermarket half-price day and then has nowhere in her tiny flat to put them, so they end up under the bed, in the shoe cabinet and lined along the bathtub
tracks.caption: Cantonese Philly sweet-soul vocal group, 1970s string-soul strut with a Hong Kong street flavour. Harp glissandos, swelling violins with pizzicato strings, wah-wah rhythm guitar chank, congas, fat round bass with brushed-snare backbeat. Plush warm analog studio sheen, lush strings over tight wah guitar. Female alto lead, cheeky and punchy, two backing sisters answering in silky close harmony, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, Eb major. Swooning, sly money comedy, comic strut. No four-on-the-floor kick, no synths, no autotune, no rap, no vibraphone, no horn section, no trap drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
超市門口貼住大字
豉油今日半價
我諗住慳返一百蚊
一嘢買咗三十支

[Pre-Chorus]
收銀姐姐望住我
問我係咪開餐廳

[Chorus]
三十支豉油 三十支豉油
擺喺邊度好呢
慳咗一百蚊好開心
屋企冇位企

[Verse]
床底塞咗八支
鞋櫃放埋六支
浴缸邊排成一行
沖涼好似去閱兵

[Pre-Chorus]
男朋友上嚟食飯
一開雪櫃又跌兩支

[Chorus]
三十支豉油 三十支豉油
擺喺邊度好呢
佢話不如開間餐廳
招牌就叫豉油王

[Verse]
炒菜我落多兩羹
煲湯我都加少少
朋友生日送一支
仲剩返二十一支

[Bridge]
超市又貼大字
今日醋都半價
我掩住眼行過去

[Chorus]
三十支豉油 三十支豉油
食到過年未完
慳咗一百蚊好開心
下次唔好咁貪心

[Chorus]
三十支豉油 三十支豉油
擺喺邊度好呢
慳咗一百蚊好開心
屋企冇位企

[Outro]
二十一支 二十支
慢慢食 慢慢諗

tracks.title: 退倒轉來的批 Thè Tò-tńg--lâi ê Phue
tracks.subject: a husband married twenty-five years who finds in a shoebox the postcard he mailed her from army training in 1999, returned for a wrong house number, and hand-delivers it across the kitchen table; she reads it aloud and writes her reply on a fridge note
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien new-age piano pop, Yiruma-style spacious ballad. Felt-hammer grand piano playing flowing broken-chord arpeggios and a simple singing right-hand motif; bamboo dizi flute answering between lines; warm sustained pad swelling under the chorus; fretless bass holding long root notes; soft brushed shaker, no kick drum. Spacious airy hall reverb on the piano, intimate close-miked vocal. Warm male baritone lead, clearly sung melody, soft female harmony on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 82 BPM, D major. Wistful, warm, tender married love. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no trap beat, no autotune, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
鞋盒仔底 一張明信片
九九年的郵戳 黃黃
門牌寫毋著 一个字
退倒轉來 囥二十五冬

[Pre-Chorus]
成功嶺的日頭 曝甲我黑
字寫甲歪歪 攏咧想你

[Chorus]
這張批 今仔日才到
我行過灶跤 交予你
你目鏡掛起來 咧笑
講 你的字 猶原遮爾歪

[Verse]
彼時你蹛 公館的巷仔
我寫成 隔壁的號碼
我等無批 你等無人
險險 咱就按呢錯過

[Pre-Chorus]
放假彼工 我去揣你
你問我 哪攏無寫

[Chorus]
這張批 今仔日才到
桌頂的茶 猶燒燒
你一字一字 唸出聲
我面紅甲 像少年

[Verse]
你講 你欲回批
寫佇冰箱 便條紙
我有收著 我嘛想你
今仔暗 換你洗碗

[Bridge]
二十五年 遲到的話
你嘛 無嫌傷慢

[Chorus]
這張批 今仔日才到
我行過灶跤 交予你
你共伊 夾入相簿
講 這張 上界媠

[Outro]
遲到的批 準時的你
規世人 慢慢仔讀

tracks.title: 摺牆床
tracks.subject: a man in a 160-square-foot Tai Kok Tsui flat whose fold-down wall bed has a stuck spring, so every night at midnight he has to wrestle it down like a dance partner, and every morning it springs back up and traps his work shirt
tracks.caption: Cantonese stride-piano ragtime, silent-film slapstick feel. Stride piano with syncopated right-hand runs, plucked tenor banjo strumming, tuba oom-pah bass, brushed snare and woodblock clops. Dry vintage-room recording, honky upright piano up front, tuba and banjo close-miked. Male tenor, bright and playful, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 108 BPM, C major. Comic midnight slapstick with a tumbling, stumbling bounce. No drum machine, no synths, no autotune, no rap, no EDM drops, no electric guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
一百六呎嘅細屋企
張床收埋喺牆入面
十二點正我要瞓覺
佢又死都唔肯落嚟

[Pre-Chorus]
彈弓卡住咗
我雙手攬實佢

[Chorus]
摺牆床 同我跳隻舞
一二三 拉低少少
你唔好再彈返上去
今晚我想瞓得好

[Verse]
左腳踩住床尾鐵架
右手扯住張被單
樓下阿伯敲天花板
以為我喺度開派對

[Pre-Chorus]
我話唔好意思
我同張床拍緊拖

[Chorus]
摺牆床 同我跳隻舞
一二三 拉低少少
樓下阿伯你唔使嬲
佢跳完就肯落嚟

[Verse]
朝早七點鬧鐘一響
佢砰一聲彈返上牆
我件恤衫夾咗喺度
返工又要遲到半粒鐘

[Bridge]
老闆問我做乜遲到
我話我張床唔肯放手
佢好掛住我

[Chorus]
摺牆床 同我跳隻舞
一二三 放開我件衫
今晚十二點再約你
記住畀面唔好彈

[Chorus]
摺牆床 同我跳隻舞
一二三 拉低少少
你唔好再彈返上去
今晚我想瞓得好

[Chorus]
摺牆床 同我跳隻舞
一二三 拉低少少
你唔好再彈返上去
今晚我想瞓得好

[Outro]
一百六呎 一張床
夜夜都同我跳舞
